meta.name: seo-plan
meta.description: Strategic SEO planning for new or existing websites. Industry-specific templates, competitive analysis, content strategy, and implementation roadmap. Use when user says "SEO plan", "SEO strategy", "SEO planning", "content strategy", "keyword strategy", "content calendar", "site architecture", or "SEO roadmap".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制定网站SEO策略，生成行业模板与执行路线图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为网站制定SEO计划或优化搜索排名
copy.tagline_en: Create SEO strategies with industry templates and implementation roadmaps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning SEO for a website or aiming to improve search rankings

howto.what: Claude 会引导你完成 SEO 规划流程，包括业务发现、竞争分析、网站架构设计、内容策略、技术基础和实施路线图，最终输出一份完整的 SEO 策略文档。
howto.when: 当你说出“SEO plan”、“SEO strategy”、“SEO planning”、“content strategy”、“keyword strategy”、“content calendar”、“site architecture”或“SEO roadmap”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个 SaaS 公司的 SEO 计划。
say.note: Claude 会加载 SaaS 行业模板并开始规划。

say.text: 我需要一个本地服务网站的 SEO 策略。
say.note: Claude 会使用本地服务模板并考虑本地 SEO 设置。

say.text: 为我的电商网站制定 SEO 路线图。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含实施阶段和 KPI 目标的计划。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through SEO planning: discovery, competitive analysis, site architecture, content strategy, technical foundation, and a phased implementation roadmap, outputting a complete SEO strategy document.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "SEO plan", "SEO strategy", "SEO planning", "content strategy", "keyword strategy", "content calendar", "site architecture", or "SEO roadmap".

say_en.text: Create an SEO plan for a SaaS company.
say_en.note: Claude loads the SaaS template and starts planning.

say_en.text: I need an SEO strategy for a local service business.
say_en.note: Claude uses the local service template and considers local SEO.

say_en.text: Make an SEO roadmap for my e-commerce site.
say_en.note: Claude generates a plan with phases and KPI targets.
